title: Peruvian Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish from Peru, typically made with raw fish marinated in citrus juices.
instructions: Cut the fish into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lime juice, corn, onion, and cilantro.
Pour the lime juice mixture over the fish, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve the ceviche chilled, with tortilla chips or toasted bread on the side.
